>>> Multiplying this by $ \frac{47}{2} $ gives $ \frac{47}{2} \times 1008 = 47 \times 504 $.
>>> Finally, calculating $ 47 \times 504 $ gives $ 23688 $.
>>> Therefore, the sum of all integers from 1 to 1000 that are divisible by both 3 and 7 is $ 23688 $.
